column7: structural half of stale-group-project-save-001/002/003 (#2697): asserts all FOUR entry points (core.UpdateGroup, ReplaceSCIMGroup, PatchSCIMGroup, core.UpdateProject) persist through UpdateGroupFields/UpdateProjectFields and that both LocalStorage bodies are a Where+Updates with no Save and no Select("*"). The two SCIM rename paths are covered deliberately, not just the two the issue's title names -- they are the likelier trigger (IdP DELETE then PUT) and leaving them out would guard the less exposed half. The deleted UpdateGroup/UpdateProject are named as forbidden so re-adding either turns this red. Runs without a Postgres DSN
